## Conclusion

The recount is complete. I read all four rooms in full (channel history returned `has_more: false` for each), then opened every thread to recover the actual reply authors — the parent `reply_count` summary matched the returned replies in all 17 threads, so the summary line and the thread contents agree. Hidden and bot posts were counted (a hidden `file_share` reply in security-v3-065 thread `1771197450.697300` and a `bot_message` reply in thread `1771354654.490792`).

**Totals across the four rooms:**

| metric | value |
|---|---:|
| messages_in_total | 56 |
| replies_in_total | 25 |
| threads_with_replies | 17 |
| people_who_replied | 15 |
| replies_from_outside_the_openers | 4 |

Per room: general-meshworks-security 11/3/2, security-095 11/4/2, security-v1-041 15/7/6, security-v3-065 19/11/7.

The one judgement call: "something that started a thread" = a top-level message (the request contrasts it with "a reply"), so a standalone top-level message with zero replies still makes its author an "opener." That makes the 4 outside-the-openers replies come from three accounts that only ever replied and never posted top-level: `UGLE5KBIBJI9` (2 replies), `UCOCV576CWC1` (1), `UV4OASVMMBZF` (1).
